notes.subject: מתחולל / יחול
notes.rationale: Both are from the same root חול (ho tshikinya, ho sesiusa); sefufu se sesiuetseng se tla sesiusa — motsotso o mong o qetile ka sehlooho se le seng, o sieo ka ho Sesotho

notes.subject: יחול
notes.rationale: Radikaleng: ho tshikinyetsa, ho itlhahloba; Sephetolelo sa KJV 'it shall fall grievously', sa JPS 'it shall whirl' — 'se tla sepelisa mahlonoko'

notes.subject: bahopedi ba ntseng ba palama
notes.rationale: הנה e bitela mobadi hore a bone sefufu se tlang

translation: Bonang, sefufu sa Yahwe — tlolo e ntse e tsoha; mme sefufu se sesiuetseng se tla sepelisa mahlonoko hodima dihlogo tsa bahlwefutsi.
